AddDataFormTemplateSpec.Name: Constituent Pet Add Data Form (Stored Procedure)
AddDataFormTemplateSpec.Description: A stored-procedure based data form for adding constituent pet records
AddDataFormTemplateSpec.Author: Styons Software

create procedure USR_SSC_USP_DATAFORMTEMPLATE_ADD_CONSTITUENTPET ( @ID uniqueidentifier = null output ,@CONSTITUENTID uniqueidentifier ,@CHANGEAGENTID uniqueidentifier = null ,@PETNAME nvarchar(1000) = '' ,@PETIMAGE varbinary(max) = null ,@PETIMAGEFILENAME nvarchar(500) = '' ) as begin set nocount on set @ID = isnull(@id,newid()) if @CHANGEAGENTID is null exec USP_CHANGEAGENT_GETORCREATECHANGEAGENT @CHANGEAGENTID output declare @now datetime = getdate()
begin try insert into USR_SSC_CONSTITUENTPET (ID, CONSTITUENTID, PETNAME, PETIMAGE, PETIMAGEFILENAME, ADDEDBYID, CHANGEDBYID, DATEADDED, DATECHANGED) values (@ID, @CONSTITUENTID, @PETNAME, @PETIMAGE, @PETIMAGEFILENAME, @CHANGEAGENTID, @CHANGEAGENTID, @now, @now) end try begin catch exec USP_RAISE_ERROR return 1 end catch return 0 end
